blurb: Windows on the world, kept open for anyone who finds them. No account, no paywall, no tracking added by us.
provenance: Canonical copy lives in the homepage repo (projects/homepage/amenities.json) and is baked verbatim into every lighthouse image by mkimg-armbian.sh; tests/smoke.sh asserts those two are byte-identical. THIS copy is the public mirror and is canon minus any entry whose URL carries a mesh-private identifier (.ts.net, .onion, RFC1918 or CGNAT), because publishing those would disclose part of the internal map — the reason this repo was seeded rather than forked. Omitted here by that rule: House Cinema.
